title: Head Injury
immediate_warning: Any loss of consciousness, vomiting, or confusion after a head injury requires immediate hospital attention.

description: Head injuries can range from minor cuts to serious brain injuries. Always take head injuries seriously, especially in children.

signs: Clear fluid from nose or ears

steps.instruction: Call 112 if unconscious, vomiting, confused, or if there is clear fluid from nose/ears.

instruction_translations.en: Call 112 if unconscious, vomiting, confused, or if there is clear fluid from nose/ears.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Call 112 if unconscious, vomiting, confused, or if there is clear fluid from nose/ears.

instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Call 112 if unconscious, vomiting, confused, or if there is clear fluid from nose/ears.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Call 112 if unconscious, vomiting, confused, or if there is clear fluid from nose/ears.

steps.instruction: Keep the person still. Do not move them if a neck injury is possible.

instruction_translations.en: Keep the person still. Do not move them if a neck injury is possible.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Keep the person still. Do not move them if a neck injury is possible.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Keep the person still. Do not move them if a neck injury is possible.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Keep the person still. Do not move them if a neck injury is possible.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Keep the person still. Do not move them if a neck injury is possible.

steps.instruction: Apply gentle pressure to any scalp wound with a clean cloth to stop bleeding.

instruction_translations.en: Apply gentle pressure to any scalp wound with a clean cloth to stop bleeding.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Apply gentle pressure to any scalp wound with a clean cloth to stop bleeding.

instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Apply gentle pressure to any scalp wound with a clean cloth to stop bleeding.

steps.instruction: Do not remove any object embedded in the head.

instruction_translations.en: Do not remove any object embedded in the head.

instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Do not remove any object embedded in the head.

steps.instruction: Monitor consciousness — speak to them regularly and check their responses.

instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Monitor consciousness — speak to them regularly and check their responses.

steps.instruction: If unconscious but breathing, place in recovery position on their side.

do_not: Do not leave a head-injured person alone for 24 hours.
Do not allow them to sleep unless assessed by a doctor.
